f.title: Submit PSURs per EURD list dates, periods and submission category
f.statement: The PSUR is submitted to ALIMS in line with the dates and periods for PSUR submission, and the submission/non-submission category, defined for the medicine in the European Union reference dates list (EURD list).
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023)
f.processes: Aggregate reporting; Submission operations; Regulatory intelligence

rows.quote: 1. PSUR se dostavlja ALIMS-u u skladu sa definisanim datumima i periodima za podnošenje PSUR-a, kao i kategorijom za podnošenje, odnosno nepodnošenje PSUR-a, koji su za određene lekove definisani u Listi referentnih datuma Evropske unije (European Union reference dates list, EURD lista).
rows.review_note: Review: full two-page guidance (not a landing page); re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 1. The PSUR is submitted to ALIMS in accordance with the defined dates and periods for PSUR submission, as well as the category for submission or non-submission of the PSUR, which are defined for certain medicines in the European Union reference dates list (EURD list).

f.title: No routine PSURs for generics, well-established use and homeopathic medicines unless the EURD list requires
f.statement: This means there is routinely no obligation to submit PSURs for generic medicines, medicines with well-established use of the active substance and homeopathic medicines, unless the EURD list defines otherwise.
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023)
f.applicability: Generic, well-established use and homeopathic medicines
f.exceptions: Unless the EURD list defines otherwise

rows.quote: To podrazumeva da rutinski ne postoji obaveza dostavljanja PSUR-a za generičke lekove, lekove sa dobro poznatom upotrebom aktivne supstance i homeopatske lekove, izuzev ako se drugačije ne definiše u EURD listi.
rows.review_note: Review: full two-page guidance (not a landing page); re-translated the quote independently; agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: This means that there is routinely no obligation to submit PSURs for generic medicines, medicines with well-established use of the active substance and homeopathic medicines, unless otherwise defined in the EURD list.

f.title: Substances not in the EURD list: ALIMS may accept EU/manufacturer periodicity or require Rulebook Art. 24(2) periodicity
f.statement: Where the active substance or combination is not in the EURD list, ALIMS may approve PSUR submission per the periodicity and deadlines of an EU country or the manufacturer's country, or may require submission under Article 24(2) of the Rulebook: every six months for the first two years after placing on the market, then once a year for the next two years, then every three years.
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023) Art. 24(2)
f.applicability: Active substances or combinations not in the EURD list

rows.quote: Ukoliko aktivna supstanca, odnosno kombinacija aktivnih supstanci nije sadržana u EURD listi: 2. ALIMS može da odobri dostavljanje PSUR-a u skladu sa periodičnošću i rokovima dostavljanja u zemlji Evropske unije, odnosno zemlji proizvođača ili 3. ALIMS može da zahteva dostavljanje PSUR-a u skladu sa članom 24. stav 2. Pravilnika (na svakih šest meseci prve dve godine nakon stavljanja leka u promet, potom jednom godišnje u naredne dve godine, a zatim na svake tri godine).

rows.quote_en: If the active substance or combination of active substances is not included in the EURD list: 2. f.title: Submit a PSUR on ALIMS's special request
f.statement: A PSUR must also be submitted at ALIMS's special request.
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023)

f.title: PSUR in PBRER format per Rulebook Annex 3, GVP VII and ICH E2C(R2)
f.statement: The PSUR is submitted to ALIMS as a PBRER, with content per Annex 3 of the Rulebook, aligned with GVP Module VII and ICH E2C(R2).
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023) Annex 3
f.systems: PBRER; ICH E2C(R2); GVP Module VII

rows.quote:
PSUR se podnosi ALIMS-u u formi PBRER dokumenta, čiji je sadržaj dat u Prilogu 3. Pravilnika, a usklađen je sa Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practices (GVP) Modul VII - Periodic safety update report i ICH Guideline E2C (R2) Periodic Benefit-
Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER).

rows.quote_en: The PSUR is submitted to ALIMS in the form of a PBRER document, whose content is given in Annex 3 of the Rulebook and is aligned with the Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practices (GVP) Module VII - Periodic safety update report and ICH Guideline E2C (R2) Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER).

f.title: PSURs covering one year or less: submit within 70 days of DLP
f.statement: A PSUR covering a period of one year or less is submitted to ALIMS at the latest 70 days from the data lock point (DLP).
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023)

f.statement: A PSUR covering a period longer than one year is submitted to ALIMS at the latest 90 days from the DLP.

f.title: Submit PSURs per the ALIMS PV submissions instruction (Subject NCF-5)
f.statement: The MAH submits the PSUR to ALIMS in accordance with the Instruction on the manner of submitting pharmacovigilance submissions by MAHs (Subject NCF-5: PSUR).
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023)

f.title: Pay the PSUR processing fee; ALIMS then processes and confirms
f.statement: ALIMS processes the submitted PSUR and issues a confirmation of administrative processing after the MAH has settled the financial obligations under the applicable tariff.
f.legal_basis: Pravilnik o načinu prijavljivanja, prikupljanja i praćenja neželjenih reakcija na lekove (Sl. glasnik RS 64/2011, 75/2017, 82/2017, 107/2023)
